posts.name: dif.sh
posts.tagline: Markdown feature flags your coding agent installs for you
posts.description: Open source feature flags as markdown files in your repo: the flag, the reason, the decision in one file, reviewed in a PR. One command, no account, so your coding agent can finish the install. A/B tests wait in the same files until you have traffic.

posts.name: Reflexio
posts.tagline: Behavioral learning that makes AI agents better over time
posts.description: Reflexio makes AI agents better with every interaction. When users correct an agent, a path fails, or something works particularly well, Reflexio turns that experience into behavior the agent can reuse next time. Instead of leaving valuable lessons buried in logs, your agent continuously learns what to repeat and what to avoid — with every learning visible, testable, and reversible. Reduce task failure rate by more than 30%, while saving tokens by more than 60%.

posts.name: Hyperprobe
posts.tagline: Lets your AI agents debug production without redeploying
posts.description: HyperProbe is how backend teams debug production issues they can't reproduce locally. Instead of adding a log line and waiting on a deploy, we let Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor drop read-only probes into a running service and capture the variable state that was never recorded. From there your agent debugs like it has a local repro, closing the bug in one sitting.

posts.name: Ponytail
posts.tagline: Make new code the last resort
posts.description: Ponytail is a plugin that makes coding agents write the least code that works. Before adding anything, it checks whether the change is needed, already exists, or can use the stdlib or a native API. Same behavior, fewer lines to own.

posts.name: at8pm
posts.tagline: Your honest journal
posts.description: Every entry you write today locks at the time that you configured — 8pm by default. Once it locks, that's it: no editing, no rewriting history, no quietly polishing what you actually felt in the moment. Just an honest, raw, and unfiltered record of your day. Entries sync across your devices with your own private iCloud and never with a first/third-party server. When typing is not enough, record a squope (square video) or an audio note. at8pm is free to download (up to 2 entries per day).

posts.name: Experiential Labs
posts.tagline: Open source AI gateway turning traffic into a better model
posts.description: Experiential is the open source, zero markup gateway for BYOK, self-hosted and 1000+ marketplace models. It learns from your traffic to cut costs, recommend better models, and train a specialized model you own.

posts.name: PostBox
posts.tagline: Stage and post designs from your mac
posts.description: PostBox turns the MacBook notch into a drag and drop poster for the work you make. Drag an export in, write the caption once, and post to X, Bluesky, Threads, LinkedIn, Dribbble, Instagram, Threads, Pinterest Behance and Cosmos at once.

posts.name: CommuteBar
posts.tagline: Live commute times in your menu bar
posts.description: Glance at traffic. Leave on time. CommuteBar puts live commute times visibly on your Mac menu bar, no app-switching required. Save multiple destinations like office, school, gym. Schedule automatic switching for recurring commutes and get leave soon / leave now indicators and optional notifications. You also get route comparison, delayed traffic alerts and different travel modes.

posts.name: Queuebrick
posts.tagline: The Letterboxd alternative
posts.description: Fast, elegant movie tracking. Search a film, rate it, queue it, rank what to watch next. The Letterboxd alternative.

posts.name: BrickForgerAI
posts.tagline: Turn any prompt into a brick set you can actually build
posts.description: Type a prompt, get a buildable brick model. The AI (image + mesh gen) is just the front door. The real work is the brick-placing engine: voxelizing the shape, tiling it with actual LEGO-compatible parts, staggering seams for strength, running structural analysis (gravity load) to catch weak points, then refining with slopes and tiles (currently a 55 part brick library). You get a realldr file, parts list, and step-by-step PDF instructions. Renders below done with the Mecabricks Advanced add-on.

posts.name: Retold
posts.tagline: Turn family voices into hand-drawn story films
posts.description: Record a memory or import an old voice note. Retold keeps the real voice and turns the story into a hand-drawn film and readable book. The sketches follow the people, places and little details as they are spoken, then every memory is kept together on your family shelf.

posts.name: GitWarren
posts.tagline: Review code with your coding agents before committing
posts.description: It’s a local, PR-like code review app that works directly with your working tree. You can review committed, staged, unstaged, and untracked changes, leave inline comments, and organize the work into actual reviews without having to push anything anywhere. You connect whatever AI you're using through MCP and have a coherent experience without all the mundane copy-pasting. All comments live in threads attached to specific code changes, so it’s easy to follow what’s going on over time.

posts.name: ​​AI Agents Listing​
posts.tagline: ​​The agentic AI ecosystem, in one directory​
posts.description: A directory of the agentic AI stack: AI agents that do real work, MCP servers that connect them to your tools and data, and agent skills that extend what they can do. Every listing gets an indexable page, and pages link across the three layers, so an agent shows the MCP servers it works with and the skills that extend it. Search, categories, comparisons and alternatives run across all of it. Listing is free.

posts.name: LiftmyCV 3.0
posts.tagline: Your personal AI job search & auto-apply agent.
posts.description: Meet the brand-new LiftmyCV 3.0, an all-in-one AI job search platform that matches you with relevant jobs, generates job-specific resumes and cover letters, and applies on your behalf. This version introduces a new user interface, a Job Hub with 1.6M+ job openings, and 5 auto-apply modes, including First and Stealth Apply, which automatically scan jobs posted within the past 24 hours, match them to your profile, and apply autonomously – no Chrome extension required.

posts.name: Malyatko — Baby tracker
posts.tagline: Privacy-first baby tracker that works fully offline
posts.description: Malyatko is a privacy-first baby tracker for the first years. Unlike most trackers it needs no account, shows no ads, and works fully offline — your baby's data stays on your device and iCloud, not a server. Track 18 activity types (sleep, feeding, diapers, weight, temperature, meds) with charts, development milestones, AI insights that turn your logs into simple tips, and sleep predictions. Apple Watch, widgets, and iCloud family sharing. Free, with optional premium.

posts.name: Muse Spark 1.3
posts.tagline: Meta’s flagship for coding and long-horizon agents
posts.description: Muse Spark 1.3 is Meta’s latest flagship for agentic work and coding. Same $1.25 / $4.25 API price as 1.2, with about 20% fewer tool calls and 25% fewer tokens on coding in Meta’s own comparisons. It leads DeepSWE v1.1 at 75.4 and ties Terminal-Bench 2.1 at 88.8. Live today in Muse Code and the Meta Model API. Max reasoning follows after safety testing.

posts.name: Brain Rest
posts.tagline: Don’t let your browser rot your brain
posts.description: Brain Rest turns browser screen time into a character you’ll actually want to protect. See every site and tab in one dashboard, watch your Brain Level shift from Fresh to Dead, and use an on-page widget to stay aware without breaking your flow. When awareness isn’t enough, set daily website limits, block distracting sites, start Focus Mode or Pomodoro, and take guided breaks. Available for Chrome and Edge with a free plan and optional Pro features.

posts.name: Traction

posts.name: TagVitals
posts.tagline: Free GA4 & GTM audit from a URL. No OAuth. No paywall.
posts.description: Most GA4/GTM audit tools want Google OAuth to read your property from the inside, or hand you a static checklist. TagVitals asks for neither. Paste a URL, wait 30 seconds. It scrapes the rendered page and the public gtm.js container, parses it without regex, then checks consent mode, dual tagging, dataLayer order and conversions. The score comes from code, not the AI - Gemini only writes the fix steps. Free, no account, full PDF export. Built by a data analyst auditing client sites daily.

posts.name: Embaze
posts.tagline: simple and secure analytics
posts.description: Embaze is a lightweight, cookie-free analytics platform. One script tracks pageviews, referrers, countries, devices and custom events in a live dashboard.

posts.name: AuditReady
posts.tagline: SOC 2 & ISO 27001 without the enterprise price tag
posts.description: AuditReady keeps frameworks, policies, tasks and evidence in one place so a 5–50 person team can answer vendor security questionnaires in an afternoon and walk into an audit prepared. Seeded SOC 2 & ISO 27001 controls • Policy mapping • Task ownership • Private evidence vault • One-click audit packs

posts.name: NeuroDB
posts.tagline: A calmer, structured community for neurodivergent life
posts.description: NeuroDB is a pseudonymous peer-support community for people managing ADHD, autism, and other conditions through prescribed treatment approaches. Unlike general forums, it's organized around structured communities with optional wellness and medication flair, so context is visible without oversharing.

posts.name: Vigil
posts.tagline: Close the lid. Claude Code keeps working. Then it sleeps.
posts.description: Vigil keeps your MacBook awake with the lid closed while Claude Code, Codex, a build or an export runs, and puts it to sleep the moment the job is done. Battery floor, heat guard, a Reminder on your phone, a history of every hold. One password, once.

posts.name: AudioKit
posts.tagline: 30+ free audio tools in your browser. Fast,private,unlimited
posts.description: AudioKit is a completely free, privacy-first audio editor in your browser. With over 30 professional tools powered by WebAssembly, you can trim, convert, pitch-shift, and edit audio instantly. No uploads, no sign-ups, no file size limits.

posts.name: StoveOps
posts.tagline: StoveOps brings the front of house into a single place
posts.description: StoveOps unites your restaurant’s page, menu, digital waitlist and guest messaging in one browser-based platform. Higher plans add reservations, team roles and advanced reporting. Track campaign results and communicate by SMS, WhatsApp or email, without extra hardware. Plans start at $49/month, with 20% off annual billing. A 7-day trial requires a card and becomes a paid subscription automatically unless you cancel before it ends.

posts.name: easy2share
posts.tagline: Secure phone-to-desktop clipboard and file sharing
posts.description: easy2share is a secure way to share clipboard text and files from a phone to another device in a browser without cloud storage, accounts, or a relay server.

posts.name: ChoiceTrace
posts.tagline: Six AI perspectives, including your past self
posts.description: ChoiceTrace turns difficult decisions into structured discussions between six AI perspectives. They challenge assumptions, vote independently, produce a clear recommendation and next step, and save the decision for later review. Relevant lessons from past choices can return when a new decision needs them.

posts.name: BubSync
posts.tagline: The shared baby tracker that keeps your village in sync.
posts.description: It takes a village, and BubSync keeps yours in sync. Track feeds, sleep, nappies and more in one shared timeline, with real-time family sync, effortless handovers, memories and an AI hub grounded in your baby’s data.

posts.name: RoleMapr
posts.tagline: Stop Applying Blindly. Get Jobs That Fit You.
posts.description: Aggregate jobs from company career pages. Match against your resume. Identify missing skills. Track applications.

posts.name: Tiny Hands Play
posts.tagline: Free browser games for toddlers. No ads, no apps, no fuss
posts.description: Nine free browser games for toddlers and kids aged 6 months to 9 years. No installs, no accounts, no ads. Open the site, hand over the keyboard or tablet, and play. Babies smash keys in Kaboom Keys and Ball Bonanza. Toddlers stack blocks in Stack It Up, steer a balloon in Balloon Float, and fly a rocket in Rocket Ride. Older kids learn letters in Spell It Out, tunes in Melody Maker, and explore Tiny Town. Add it to your home screen for full-screen play on car trips and plane rides.

posts.name: PokerAdmin
posts.tagline: Run professional poker tournaments from your phone
posts.description: Managing a poker tournament means juggling blind levels, seating, prizes, and registrations — usually from a dedicated laptop with clunky software. PokerAdmin runs on any device. No install needed. ✓ Live blind clock with break timer ✓ Player PWA — register, follow clock, report chips from their phone ✓ Automatic prize pool ✓ Cash game tables ✓ Leagues & standings ✓ English and Spanish Built for poker rooms and serious home games.

posts.name: SignalGlow
posts.tagline: Turn your phone into a real-world flirting signal
posts.description: SignalGlow turns your phone screen into a real-world availability signal. Show green when you're open to being approached and red when you're not. Inspired by traffic-light parties, it helps people connect offline—without profiles, matching, or swiping.

posts.name: Math Combat: Mental math
posts.tagline: Fast-paced arcade math combat, set to a pounding beat
posts.description: Math Combat: Mental Math is a fast-paced arcade game that turns mental math into a beat-driven battle. Solve equations under pressure, chain combos, and level up your speed all set to a pounding EDM soundtrack. No boring drills, just pure math adrenaline. 🎧🧠

posts.name: DocSanitizer
posts.tagline: Censor private PII & shrink docs to fit any AI prompt
posts.description: DocSanitizer is a zero-cloud, privacy-first document sanitizer. Censor private data & shrink docs to fit into any AI prompt. 100% on-device, no telemetry, no cloud.

posts.name: Tully Courses
posts.tagline: Stop watching tutorials. Learn by actually doing it.
posts.description: Learn anything by doing it. For builders, dreamers, and doers: Tully turns any goal into a hands-on course, checks what you can actually do, and adapts the path to you.

posts.name: KTAVA Bible
posts.tagline: Free of Ads, clean and progressive reading!
posts.description: KTAVA is a calm, private Bible reader built to help you read with focus and understand with depth—without ads or a required account or subscriptions.

posts.name: Paglipat
posts.tagline: Plan your move to Southeast Asia, not just your trip
posts.description: Paglipat helps you figure out where to go, which visa fits, what it costs, where to stay, and what to do next. Compare cities, build a relocation checklist, explore long-stay housing, and book the trip when you're ready.

posts.name: ToRankOnAI
posts.tagline: Check if ChatGPT actually recommends your local business
posts.description: See whethToRankOnAI is a 60-second visibility auditor built for local brands and digital marketing agencies. It simulates over 20+ live recommendation prompts directly through ChatGPT to generate a comprehensive 0-100 AI Visibility Score. Get a full AI Visibility Audit with scores, recommendation tests, evidence and priority actions.
